title: Platform
desc: Vikram and Raju are brothers who work in a restaurant. When a conniving person frames Vikram in a murder case and separates them, circumstances lead Raju to a life of crime.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: A naive village girl marries the son of a domineering man. However, upon her arrival at his house in the city, she finds out that he is already married.

title: Krishna
desc: The life of Sunil, an aspiring pilot, takes a disastrous turn when he is falsely convicted for a crime he did not commit.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.
